services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Our pontoon charters are the perfect way to explore Lake George without the stress of driving. One of our experienced local captains will guide you around the lake, taking you to the best swimming spots, scenic views, and hidden gems only a true Lake George local would know. Whether you're looking to cruise, celebrate, or just soak up the sun, all you have to do is hop on board-we’ll handle the rest. blurb: Guests can rent boats to explore Lake George at their own pace or join public cruises to enjoy scenic views and regional history. The business also offers dining at The Lighthouse Grill and hosts events such as weddings and corporate gatherings with lake views. Parasailing adventures and themed cruises like the Princess Cruise are available.
